  • Job Title: ACTRV000199 - Staff Engineer
  • Location: San Francisco, New York City
  • Duration: Full-Time
  • Pay Rate/Salary: $100,000 - $200,000

Description: Role:
Staff Engineer Build the context + orchestration layer for AI-first revenue software

Our client's team is building an AI-first revenue platform a collective intelligence layer that connects messy, real-world data into context that AI agents can learn from and act on autonomously. The goal is simple: replace busywork with action that compounds revenue per representative, less digging through dashboards and more time moving sales pipelines.

If you're entrepreneurial and want to help define what AI-native software looks like how data becomes context, how agents plan and act, and how chat turns into outcomes, this is the place to build. The team ships in tight loops, learns in public, and measures success by customer impact.

What you'll do
Create the collective memory. Ingest and unify data from many sources (CRM and beyond) into a semi-structured context graph that captures what leads to winning deals modeled at multiple levels with strong tenant isolation.

Orchestrate agentic systems. Design planner/executor patterns, tools, and policies (including MCP-style interfaces) that turn context into content and then into actions. Define simple eval harnesses to measure quality.

Deliver where users work. Expose capabilities through native surfaces (apps, chat, and integrations) in tight loops with product and GTM reducing context switches and meta-work.

Prove outcomes. With product and customers, define success metrics (e.g. tasks auto-completed, adoption/retention, pipeline lift; keep latency in check) and wire observability so we can ship learn iterate quickly.

Balance cost & reliability. Tune accuracy, latency, and cost for agent runs and retrieval; design fallbacks and safeguards that keep the system dependable under real-world load.


What you'll bring
Owner/builder mindset with product taste you frame problems, choose the simplest path, and own outcomes.

4+ years building & owning backend/platform systems end-to-end, with 01 wins and measurable business impact.
Curious by default; comfortable taking smart risks and turning fuzzy problems into shipped outcomes.

You talk in terms of impact and trade-offs; decide with ~70% info; turn ambiguity into simple, testable systems.

Experience stitching messy, multi-source data into something a product can reason over; strong instincts for reliability, privacy, and multi-tenant boundaries.

Able to hit the ground running with Python and standing up cloud infrastructure.

Nice to have: exposure to agent orchestration/planning, retrieval/graph-shaped context, eval frameworks, and distributed systems at scale.

Description:
Manager, AI and Practice Solutions to lead a portfolio of litigation and discovery practice technologies. This role will oversee both off-the-shelf and custom solutions designed to enhance legal service delivery and improve the client experience.

The Manager will evaluate the effectiveness of existing technology, identify and prioritize opportunities for improvement, and implement new solutions. A strong focus will be placed on change management and user adoption, supported by persuasive use cases and strategic communication.

This position requires close collaboration with Knowledge and Innovation Attorneys (KIAs), practice groups, IT, Information Security, Data Privacy, Change Management, and other colleagues across the Practice Innovation (PI) Department. The role is also client-facing, engaging with stakeholders to understand practice-specific challenges and drive process improvement through technology. The position reports to the Director of Practice Solutions.

Key Responsibilities
  • Stay informed on developments, trends, and best practices in legal technology, particularly in litigation, discovery, and generative AI.
  • Research, evaluate, and recommend innovation tools that enhance accuracy, collaboration, and service delivery.
  • Partner with KIAs, discovery attorneys, and practice groups to identify needs, assess market tools, and develop business cases for new technologies.
  • Collaborate with discovery professionals on eDiscovery best practices, including data collection, processing, AI-enabled workflows, and production.
  • Manage the full lifecycle of technology projectspiloting, vendor management, training, adoption campaigns, and performance measurement.
  • Lead adoption initiatives by developing communication strategies, training plans, and success metrics (e.g., usage reports, user surveys).
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned practice solutions and establish credibility as a trusted resource for attorneys and firm leaders.
  • Build and maintain vendor relationships, contribute to best practices, and support related projects as needed.
Required Skills & Experience
  • Project management expertise: leading complex, cross-departmental initiatives; resolving timeline, scope, and budget issues; developing detailed proposals and reports.
  • Communication and change management: strong presentation skills, ability to create training materials and adoption campaigns using digital tools, and comfort engaging firm leadership and clients.
  • Technical knowledge: deep expertise in discovery and litigation technologies (Relativity, RelOne, Opus2, Disco, Concordance, AI-driven workflows).

Professional background:
  • Bachelors degree required; JD preferred.
  • PMP or equivalent certification a plus.
  • 5+ years in project management or business analysis.
  • 5+ years in knowledge management, discovery technology/services, or IT.
  • 7+ years in a litigation-related legal or professional services environment.
  • Experience with legal applications of generative AI strongly preferred.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including superior PowerPoint design and delivery skills.

Title: Maintenance Supervisor (4RX7Y6V5)
Locations: Portland, OR
Duration: Fulltime
Rate – $ 85000.00 USD - 103000.00 USD
Schedule: 4 days on, 4 days off, 12-hour shift. Typically, shifts run from 6:00am to 6:00pm or 6:00pm to 6:00am.

Summary
Our client, a major global leader in the food and beverage industry, is seeking Maintenance Supervisors to join their manufacturing operations. In this role, you will leverage your technical expertise in both process and equipment while providing hands-on leadership to ensure reliability, efficiency, and operational excellence.

The ideal candidate will have 5+ years of supervisory experience with a proven track record in managing teams, improving equipment performance, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. You will lead diverse groups of technical and non-technical staff, contractors, and operations personnel to ensure seamless plant operations.

Key Responsibilities

People & Labor Management
Lead and manage all aspects of safety, quality, and line efficiency for the assigned shift.
Drive daily maintenance department meetings and oversee execution plans.
Recruit, train, and develop mechanics and technicians while building team skills and capabilities.
Manage union relationships and resolve conflicts professionally.
Ensure compliance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) in tooling and workshop management.
Provide tools, training, and growth opportunities for employees, fostering a culture of accountability and development.

Preventive Maintenance
  • Lead the mean time to repair (MTTR) improvement agenda and make real-time decisions to minimize downtime during unplanned stops.
  • Oversee the execution of preventive and corrective maintenance programs across the shift.
  • Provide timely feedback and documentation to update PM plans in SAP.
  • Prioritize and resolve all PM activities related to safety and quality.
  • Support breakdown analysis, root cause identification, and implementation of corrective actions.
  • Ensure on-time start-ups and production readiness, serving as the key point of contact for maintenance needs.

Additional Responsibilities
  • Optimize cost-effective maintenance and reliability (M&R) strategies in line with lean manufacturing principles.
  • Provide technical training to associates to build capabilities in a 24/7 environment.
  • Lead and refine equipment reliability plans, performance monitoring, and root cause analysis.
  • Enforce safety policies and ensure all employees receive required training and follow applicable regulations.

Qualifications
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in direct supervision of engineering, maintenance, or production staff in a manufacturing environment (required).
  • Experience working with union employees (required).
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 10 to 15 years of manufacturing plant experience preferred, with a strong background in food industry operations.
  • Proven experience managing machine technicians, electricians, and engineers.
